summary: Iter146 RETEST — Confirmed the critical dashboard makloon fix from iter145. With seed doc mres_TEST_ui (prod_batik_mega, qty 50, active), GET /api/dashboard?entity_id=ent_ksc now returns prod_batik_mega with available_qty=260 (reduced from 310) and makloon_reserved_qty=50; /api/products returns the same values — shared apply_to_products overlay works for both. Kasir UI (sales@, ?view=sales&entity=ent_ksc): desktop 1920 shows pill [data-testid=product-makloon-reserved-prod_batik_mega] text 'Dicadangkan makloon: 50 yard'; mobile 390 Katalog tab shows [data-testid=mobile-product-makloon-reserved-prod_batik_mega] text 'Dicadangkan makloon: 50'. After deleting the TEST reservation, dashboard reverts to available_qty=310 and no makloon_reserved_qty — label disappears. Escalations hub hero now reads 'Eskalasi Gudang' (sidebar + hub section both 'Eskalasi Gudang'); however, the view/breadcrumb page title at the top-left header still reads 'Eskalasi Barang Masuk & Barang Keluar' because /app/frontend/src/config/navMeta.js has a duplicate `escalations` entry at line 113 (page_titles map) that overrides the fixed line 21 entry. Minor leftover. CSS/UI consistency sweep (sampled create modals, admin role): detected native <select> elements inside modals on supplier-create, purchase-returns create, approval-rules create, doc-templates-basic create (3, 3, 3, 2 occurrences respectively) — not shadcn Select, inconsistent styling vs rest of app. Karyawan (hr-employees) create modal is taller than viewport (1518px vs 1080) — needs internal scroll or shorter height. Other probed views (customers, purchase-orders, makloon-orders, vendor-bills, cash-management) — automated create-button selectors did not match; could not verify their modals in this sweep.

ui_bugs.issue: `escalations` present twice (line 21 'Eskalasi Gudang', line 113 'Eskalasi Barang Masuk & Barang Keluar'). Second entry wins for header/breadcrumb; hub hero still reads 'Eskalasi Gudang'. Remove or unify line 113.
Uses native <select> inside dialog (3 instances) — inconsistent with shadcn Select used elsewhere; no custom chevron/search; different hover/focus ring.
Native <select> inside dialog (2 instances). Note: Ukuran kertas/Orientasi fields do use shadcn (verified iter145), but 2 remaining selects still native.
Modal content height ~1518px exceeds 1080 viewport; dialog does not scroll internally — fields below Simpan get clipped on 1080 screens. Consider max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto on content.

rca of the issue: The iter145 critical bug (makloon label missing in Kasir) was caused by backend/routers/dashboard.py building the products payload directly from db.products + inventory_balances aggregation without the material_reservations overlay, while backend/routers/products.py already called apply_to_products. SalesPortal reads data.products from /api/dashboard, so makloon_reserved_qty was always missing/0 → PosProductCard & MobileProductCard rendered no pill. Fix extracted the overlay into material_reservation_service.apply_to_products and invoked it from both routers (dashboard.py line 102). Verified via live API diff (310→260, +makloon_reserved_qty=50) and visible pills on both viewports.
